name: The Vatican Council and its Definitions
name_pt: O Concílio Vaticano e as Suas Definições
author: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning
desc: The Vatican Council and its Definitions (1870): Manning's pastoral letter to the clergy on the Council: the world and the Council, the two constitutions, the terminology of infallibility, the scientific history of the Catholic rule of faith, the tradition of England and the result of the definition, with an appendix and the English text of the two dogmatic constitutions Dei Filius and Pastor Aeternus.
desc_pt: O Concílio Vaticano e as Suas Definições (1870): carta pastoral de Manning ao clero sobre o Concílio: o mundo e o Concílio, as duas constituições, a terminologia da infalibilidade, a história científica da regra da fé católica, a tradição da Inglaterra e o resultado da definição, com um apêndice e o texto inglês das duas constituições dogmáticas Dei Filius e Pastor Aeternus.
editor: Henry Edward Manning (New York: D. and J. Sadlier, 1887)
edition: The Vatican Council and its Definitions (New York: D. and J. Sadlier, 1887), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The five chapters, the appendix and the English text of the two constitutions; the contents is dropped, and the Latin text of the constitutions is left out.
